summary: Top Ships Inc., a Greek-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Share Purchase Agreement dated October 1, 2026 with Central Mare Inc., an entity affiliated with the family of Evangelos J. Pistiolis, to acquire all shares of four SPVs holding shipbuilding contracts for four 49,940 dwt ice-class 1A MR product tankers at Guangzhou Shipyard International, each with $49.5 million installments and deliveries June 2029 through March 2030. Purchase price is approximately $34.95 million, payable by December 31, 2026; closing is conditioned on lease financing and customary terms. A special transaction committee of independent directors approved the deal supported by a fairness opinion. Watch related-party conflicts, financing execution and capital-raise clawback provisions.
